summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Builds and debugs full stack AI systems end to end, from Linux based edge deployment on NVIDIA Jetson to a Flask-SocketIO and WebSocket integration layer connecting mobile, server, and embedded components. Diagnosed and resolved 11 separate hardware and software integration failures to bring a distributed robotic pipeline to 100% reliability, and regularly communicates technical tradeoffs to both engineers and non-technical audiences while leading cross-functional teams.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API to fine tune DONUT on a custom medical billing dataset.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% by diagnosing preprocessing bottlenecks and iterating on model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset, then trained YOLOv8n to 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation data.
Exported the trained model to ONNX and TFLite and validated it for mobile deployment, handling the full path from training environment to deployable artifact.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition in a live laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and authored technical documentation for the tooling.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end to end.
Organized 10+ exhibitions and technical workshops, translating hands-on engineering work into presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic system across three components: a Flutter mobile client, a Flask-SocketIO edge server on Linux, and a Jetson+Arduino controller, connected over a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated faster-whisper, Gemini intent classification, and TensorRT-optimized YOLO, coordinating multiple external services and APIs into one reliable pipeline.
Diagnosed and resolved 11 distinct integration failures across the stack, taking the system from unreliable to 100% pick success (10/10 trials) in live testing.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization on TinyLlama 1.1B, profiling VRAM and latency to validate the deployment configuration.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC, confirming under 1% accuracy degradation for the edge deployment tradeoff.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Integrated a YOLOv8 model on NVIDIA Jetson with an STM32 controller over UART, connecting AI perception directly to physical infrastructure in real time.
